  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

public function classify(password: Text)
  returns Strength

  example: classify(password: "Abcdef12!") is Strong

  otherwise if password.length is at least 8 then
    return Fair

```renyi
module password.strength
  purpose: Classify passwords by strength.

public type Strength is one of
  purpose: Password strength categories.
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

public function classify(password: Text)
  returns Strength
  purpose: Classify a password as Weak, Fair, or Strong.
  example: classify(password: "abc") is Weak
  example: classify(password: "abcdefgh") is Fair
  example: classify(password: "Abcdef12!") is Strong

  if password.length is at least 12 and password.matches(raw ".*[A-Za-z].*") and password.matches(raw ".*[0-9].*") and password.matches(raw ".*[^A-Za-z0-9].*") then
    return Strong
  otherwise if password.length is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end
```

module password.strength
  purpose: Classify passwords by strength.

public type Strength is one of
  purpose: Password strength categories.
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

public function classify(password: Text)
  returns Strength
  purpose: Classify a password as Weak, Fair, or Strong.
  example: classify(password: "abc") is Weak
  example: classify(password: "abcdefgh") is Fair
  example: classify(password: "Abcdef12!") is Strong

  if password.length is less than 8 then
    return Weak
  otherwise if password.length is less than 12 then
    return Fair
  otherwise if password.contains("a") and password.contains("1") and password.contains("!") then
    return Strong
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end
